# Hicdaw 3-Pack Boho Yoga Headbands

Refresh your workout look with the Hicdaw 3-Pack Yoga Headbands. This set includes three bands in different colors, so you can coordinate with your activewear or switch styles from one session to the next.

## Designed for Movement

Each headband has a stretchy, moisture-wicking fabric that flexes with you through yoga flows, runs, and gym sessions. The unisex design works for anyone who wants to keep hair off their face during a workout.

## Boho Style, Your Way

The relaxed boho design adds a effortless touch to any outfit. Wear the band at full width for a bold, cozy look, or fold it for a slimmer profile. You get two styles from one accessory, without extra effort.

## Everyday Versatility

Keep a set in your gym bag, yoga mat bag, or purse so you're ready for class, a workout, or a casual day out. Comfortable and easy to style, these headbands help you look put together with minimal time spent in the mirror.

Add the Hicdaw 3-Pack to your cart today and find an accessory you'll reach for in every session.
